title: $4000 Elves Vanyar Road Bike: 1000 Miles Later // In-Depth Review!

takeaways.text: The frame cost £880 and the whole build about US$4,000, of which US$1,200 was the Winspace wheels.
Routing four lines on each side through the integrated carbon bar is a challenge.
It feels fast, light and responsive but a little more forgiving and less twitchy than a full race frame; it climbs well and feels planted on descents.
The seatpost cover flaps and keeps coming loose, and the seatpost slipped once until he fitted the supplied adhesive grip strip inside the seat tube; otherwise it has been reliable.

disclosure: Owner follow-up to his earlier Vanyar Pro 2024 unboxing; no sponsorship of this video is stated.
summary: A 1,000-mile review of a size-50 Elves Vanyar Pro 2024 built with 105 Di2 and Winspace Hyper wheels.
